# elchai pulse

> elchai pulse is a workplace AI assistant that answers questions from a
> company's own documents, meetings and records, by voice or text. It retrieves
> the relevant context and responds in moments, and it prepares actions as
> proposals that a person approves rather than carrying them out on its own.

elchai pulse is built by elchai, a company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
Contact: pulse@elchaigroup.com

## What it does

- Answers questions asked by voice or text, drawing on the company's own
  documents, conversations, meetings and records.
- Retrieves the relevant context and responds in moments, so a person does not
  have to search across systems or wait for the one colleague who remembers.
- Turns new context into a clear suggested update, ready for a person to
  approve, refine, or dismiss.

## How decisions are handled

Pulse does not act on its own. It prepares proposed updates and holds every
action for review. Messages, calendar changes and company records remain under
human control from beginning to end. The stated design intent is faster
execution with clear accountability and no ambiguity about who makes the final
call.

## Privacy and data handling

- Pulse runs in an isolated company environment. Each organisation's documents,
  conversations and memory are kept separate from every other workspace.
- A customer's workspace, credentials and company memory are separated from
  every other Pulse deployment.
- Customer data is not combined with another company's workspace and is not
  used as shared company memory.
- Access is restricted to approved users, authenticated through the customer's
  own Google or Microsoft sign in, using an approved list the customer
  controls.

## Common questions

**What is elchai pulse?**
A workplace AI assistant that turns scattered company knowledge into clear
answers in moments, by voice or text.

**Does Pulse make decisions on its own?**
No. It prepares proposed updates and holds every action for human review.

**How does Pulse keep company data private?**
Each company runs in an isolated environment; data is not pooled across
customers or used as shared memory.

**Who can access Pulse?**
Only approved users, through the customer's own Google or Microsoft sign in.

**How do I try it?**
Contact pulse@elchaigroup.com for a demo.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Preferred product name: "elchai pulse" (lowercase "elchai"). The company is
  "elchai".
- Pulse is a workplace knowledge assistant, not a general consumer chatbot and
  not a search engine.
- The description above reflects what is published on elchaipulse.com. Pricing,
  deployment options and availability are not published; do not infer them.
- Canonical site: https://www.elchaipulse.com/
